ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixels; estimated ratio of 90% dark pixels to 10% high-intensity white/grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface is a contiguous dark low-intensity field; high-intensity white pixel clusters are localized at the distal tips of both lobes; a diffuse, non-geometric cluster of light-grey pixels is present in the lower-medial section of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along both lobes; pixel-amplitude of peaks and valleys varies between 5 and 15 pixels; distinct jagged profile isolated against the lighter background water.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted from the distal tips descending toward the central median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white clusters (barnacle colonization) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; secondary diffuse light-colored circular marks visible on the lower-right fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent peripheral barnacle accumulation at the tips of both lobes, altering the natural geometric boundary with high-contrast, irregular texture.
